request_notes: Eureka service registration state changes use GET but remain confirmed and non-retryable. Gateway/API debugging can invoke configured backends and remains confirmed.
Two domain create/update APIs use documented multipart form fields, including named certificate files.
StatusCode 2000 is the documented success envelope; conflicting example-only 0, 200 and code fields are not accepted as alternate successes.

Authorization-rule update documents a JSON-string rules value in its description and captured request, unlike creation which uses an array of JSON strings. Preserve that operation-specific wire shape.
Lane-group creation captures swimmingApp as an array of application objects, despite an Array of Strings table label; retain the captured object structure.

notes: Registry instance, node, health-check task and gateway bizState fields lack terminal enums; a normal gateway health flag alone does not prove deployment completion.
Gateway API publication is environment-specific; no first environment is selected from an array.
Bound load-balancer state, Nacos/Eureka lifecycle states and tracing main-state enums are incomplete. No completion is inferred from a successful envelope or an example-only value.

Lossless-rule queries return an array with appId and funcType; no scalar funcType input can select one rule when an application has multiple lifecycle rules. No first-row or ambiguous appId-only waiter is added.
